findings.summary: The Fish template loops over newline-split output, but format_completion now emits three newline-separated lines per completion (type, value, help). Each iteration therefore sees one line, so metadata indexes are unset or out of range and Fish completion breaks.
Newlines are escaped as a literal backslash-n, and nothing in the Fish script reverses this. Descriptions show literal \n text and values containing newlines are altered.
The "_" sentinel for "no help" is overloaded. An option whose real help text is exactly "_" loses its description, and the template's `!= "_"` check at line 190 has the same problem.
The `.. versionchanged:: 8.3` note should say 8.4, since CHANGES.rst lists this change as Unreleased after 8.3.3.
The new CHANGES.rst entry has no :pr: reference.
